# assets/third_party — art made by other people

One folder per pack, kept **as downloaded** (original names), with a `.gdignore` so Godot does not
import it. Sheets we use are copied to `assets/map/` (or similar). Our own picks, tile sets and edits go
elsewhere, so a pack can be updated by replacing its folder.

| Folder | Pack | Author | License (short) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pixel_crawler/` | Pixel Crawler — Free Pack 2.11 | Anokolisa | Commercial use OK, credit not required, may edit; **may not resell the art itself**. Full text: `pixel_crawler/Terms.txt` | https://anokolisa.itch.io/free-pixel-art-asset-pack-topdown-tileset-rpg-16x16-sprites |
| `serene_village/` | Serene Village - revamped 16x16 (v1.9, free) | LimeZu | **CC BY 4.0**: commercial use + edits OK, **credit required** ("Serene Village tileset by LimeZu"). See `serene_village/LICENSE-NOTE.md` | https://limezu.itch.io/serenevillagerevamped |
| `pixel_plains/` | Pixel Plains v1.0 (free) | SnowHex (Jose Javier) | Commercial use + edits OK, **credit required**; **no resale / redistribution**, no crypto/NFT. See `pixel_plains/ReadMe.txt` | https://snowhex.itch.io/pixel-plains |
| `pixel_plains/character/` | Pixel Plains — main character (cut from the store-preview GIF by `tools/asset_viewer/pixel_plains_char.py`: 6 strips + `anims.json`) | SnowHex | The user owns the Pixel Plains pack; credit SnowHex. Check the pack's own license file for terms | https://img.itch.zone/aW1hZ2UvMjgwMTY1Ni8xNzIxNTI0MS5naWY=/original/q74igv.gif |
| `assets/map/pixel_plains/tiles.png` | Byte copy of `pixel_plains/New Basic Tiles Free.png`, made because the pack folder has `.gdignore` (the game ground, `data/maps/ground_pixel_plains.tres`, loads this) | SnowHex | Same as `pixel_plains/`: **credit required**, no resale / redistribution | https://snowhex.itch.io/pixel-plains |
